About these questions & references

500 original recall questions across 100 structures: location, function, relationships, recognition and focused recall. They are study prompts, not official past examination questions. Answers are in English; Hausa support remains available in the anatomy lessons.

Reference reading includes the NCI SEER anatomy modules and National Eye Institute. Links provide background reading, not an endorsement. Educator review of the question bank is pending. Use your course materials to resolve differences.

The 3D references show selected anatomy, with partial female bone and muscle coverage. Some whole-muscle questions link to a modelled component, identified in the explanation. Heart-wall questions use a clearly labelled teaching schematic. Anatomical variation is normal.
